title: Baltimore vs Carolina: Player Touchdowns

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Chuba Hubbard records 1 or more Touchdowns in the game between Baltimore and Carolina scheduled for November 22, 2026 at 1:00 PM ET, including overtime. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying is the number of Touchdowns recorded by the specified player for the specified game, regardless of position or unit, and excluding any touchdown pass thrown by that player. Source Agencies, in order, are NFL.com, ESPN, and FOX Sports. If the player is listed as active but does not enter the game, the Contract will resolve to the last fair price determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange. Once the player enters the game, the Contract resolves based on the player's official Touchdowns recorded as documented by the Source Agency. If the game is not played as scheduled and is not rescheduled within seven days, the Contract resolves to the last fair price determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the event is cancelled or a player has forfeited, withdrawn, or been disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process. View the [full rules](https://assets.gemini.com/predictions/terms_and_conditions/Terms_and_Conditions_NFL_Anytime_TD_Scorer_Class_c0c98e8d-a544-4786-8061-5943dd3096d8.pdf).
